text:
emma (customer): Hey team — my account consumed paid usage instead of my free-tier credits yesterday. dashboard shows 1,000 free tokens remaining but invoice applied charges. Can you help?

maria-support: Sorry about that, emma. Can you share the account id and a sample request id or timestamp?

emma (customer): acct_92fjK, sample request id: req_20260310_09:24:11 (we saw the charge at 09:25 UTC). Our policy expects free-tier credits to be used before paid tokens.

jordan-billing: Thanks — checking billing ledger now. Quick Q: did you redeem any promo credits in the last 30 days? Promo and free-tier stacks have different expiration semantics.

emma (customer): No recent promo redemptions. Only the persistent free-tier credits from signup. We also have an auto-topup card on file but we didn't expect it to be used while free credits remain.

billing-bot: Automated note — account acct_92fjK has: free_tier_remaining=1000, promo_credits=0, payment_method=active, last_invoice=2026-03-10T09:30:00Z. Invoice #INV-2338 shows token_charge=450.

maria-support: Can you paste the full raw request/response headers for the charged request (redact keys) and the usage header if present? A snippet with `X-Usage-Tokens` or `x-request-id` helps.

emma (customer): pasted snippet: ```
POST /v1/generate HTTP/1.1
Host: api.redwood.ai
Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>
X-Request-Id: req_20260310_09:24:11
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "model": "open-7b-instruct",
  "input": "Summarize this long doc...",
  "max_tokens": 1024
}
```

alex-platform: I pulled the request id — server logs show token_count=450, billing_label=paid_pool, charge_reason="insufficient_free_bucket_at_evaluate_time". That phrasing is odd — free bucket reported as available in account state but not in allocation snapshot at eval.

maria-support: Sounds like a race between the quota refresh job and request allocation. alex, can you check whether quota cache was stale for that shard at 09:24?

alex-platform: Looking — there was a short cache eviction window during our 09:20 deployment of quota service: `quota-service v2.14.0` had a migration that temporarily moved free-tier ownership to new storage with a delayed backfill. Affected window: 09:19:40 - 09:27:10 UTC on 2026-03-10. 17 requests from acct_92fjK during window.

jordan-billing: That matches invoice timing. If the allocation service couldn't see free-tier tokens, requests routed to paid pool and were billed. We need to reimburse and correct dashboard.

emma (customer): Appreciate that — what's the remediation path and timeline? I need these credits restored and charge reversed.

maria-support: Next steps: 1) Billing will issue a reversal for invoice INV-2338 (jordan). 2) Platform will mark the impacted requests as `consumed_free_credit=true` in the usage mirror so dashboard reflects true remaining balance (alex). 3) We'll add a postmortem and communicate to customers in the window.

jordan-billing: Filing reversal now, ref: REV-7901. Expect reversal to appear within 3-5 business days, immediate account credit applied pending invoice lifecycle. I'll also add a manual ledger entry to keep dashboards consistent.

alex-platform: I'll backfill the quota snapshot and reclassify the 17 requests. Script: ```
# run on platform-admin
python scripts/backfill_free_credits.py --account acct_92fjK --from 2026-03-10T09:19:00Z --to 2026-03-10T09:28:00Z --dry-run
# review then run without --dry-run
```

emma (customer): Ok thanks. One request: can you ensure this won't re-occur? Free-tier should be atomically reserved at request start.

maria-support: Agreed. Alex, can you add a guard so allocation falls back to reservation of free bucket if available, not to paid pool?

alex-platform: Yep — adding two changes: (a) improve cache warmup on deploys; (b) change allocation priority: attempt atomic `reserve(free_bucket)` with a 200ms blocking retry before falling back. We'll announce the fix in release notes.

jordan-billing: I've sent the provisional credit to the account (balance +$0.78) so the next invoice won't include the charge. REV-7901 created.

maria-support: Closing loop: emma, I'll DM you the reversal id and timeline. We'll also run a targeted audit for other accounts in same shard and proactively credit any affected. :thumbsup:

emma (customer): Thanks everyone — appreciate the quick help. :relieved:

maria-support: Filing a short postmortem and incident timeline in #incidents. Will link here when done.

billing-bot: Incident created: INC-5102 — "free-tier allocation race during quota-service migration". Notifying impacted accounts list: 24 total.

maria-support: Marking thread resolved for customer-facing follow-up.
